_comment: Self-maintained, checked-in pricing table for report-cost.sh's cost_usd
computation (design.md Decision 2 of the track-per-run-cost-spend change).
NOT fetched live, NOT authoritative — a dashboard ESTIMATE that can drift
from Anthropic's real, invoiced rates over time. Keys are the exact
`message.model` id Claude Code's own session transcript writes (the
dated form, e.g. `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929`, confirmed empirically
against a real transcript — see this change's tasks.md 7.1/7.2), not the
short alias (`sonnet`) `lib/config.js`'s modelTiers resolve to.
All rates are USD per MILLION tokens (Anthropic's own published unit).
cacheCreationPerMTok is the 5-minute ephemeral cache write rate (1.25x
the model's own inputPerMTok, per Anthropic's published multiplier);
cacheReadPerMTok is 0.1x inputPerMTok. A model id with no entry here
degrades to 'tokens known, $ unknown' (report-cost.sh omits cost_usd
entirely) rather than a guessed price — see design.md Decision 2/4.
UPKEEP OBLIGATION: seeded once, at this change's authoring time, for the
Sonnet/Opus/Haiku ids `lib/config.js`'s DEFAULT_MODEL_TIERS/FALLBACK_MODEL
resolve to for claude-code. A new model release, or a published price
change to an existing one, will NOT self-update — the project owner who
enabled costTracking.enabled is responsible for keeping this current (see
docs/config-reference.md).
